LH-HPRV-008.explanation: The insurer may examine a claimant at its own expense while a claim is pending and request an autopsy where law allows; it is one of Virginia's required uniform provisions, along with change of beneficiary, payment of claims and cancellation by insured (Va. Code § 38.2-3503). Illegal occupation, intoxicants and relation of earnings are optional provisions under § 38.2-3504.

excluded.LH-PROV-011: Free look framed generically; replaced by the Virginia 10-day item LHVA-VALIF-001 (Va. Code § 38.2-3301).
excluded.LH-PROV-004: Grace period computation; the Virginia 31-day rule is tested directly by LHVA-VALIF-002 (§ 38.2-3303).
excluded.LH-PROV-005: Reinstatement; the Virginia three-year rule is tested directly by LHVA-VALIF-003 (§ 38.2-3311).
excluded.LH-LIFE-001: Divorce and insurable interest scenario; Virginia's divorce revocation statute (§ 20-111.1) makes the facts easy to misread, so the Virginia rule is tested directly by LHVA-VALIF-005.
excluded.LH-HPRV-018: Generic 75% participation figure; Virginia small group rules are tested by state items instead.
